body:
Simplified, but I don't see why helpers weren't a good example. To answer your question @pixelastic , I don't believe so, because I'd like to keep a maximum of the the logic in a separate file with only lambdas + in the templates, and there are multiple places where you need to format a price.
And in the end, the method was just *taking an object, returning an object*, but did it knowing the underlying template engine was Hogan, that's all.
